### Type of Change
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change resolving an issue)

### Verification and Quality Checklist
<!-- Check all that apply before requesting review -->
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly locally (`mvn clean compile`).
- [ ] Unit/Integration tests pass with zero failures (`mvn test`).
- [ ] New/modified web elements contain unique, stable DOM IDs for Selenium testing.
- [ ] No hardcoded passwords, tokens, API keys, or machine-specific absolute paths are present.
- [ ] Follows 3-tier layering (Controller -> Service -> Repository).
- [ ] PR is targeted to `develop` branch (or appropriate feature branch).
